routes.title: High-genus Hodge / GFF
routes.fact: Genus 48; 96 harmonic directions. A broad finite-model crossover.

routes.title: Dubédat / dimers
routes.fact: Determinant-based candidate construction: 45 distinct directions rejected exactly.
routes.limit: This polynomial adaptation is not a dimer theorem about the target.

routes.title: Anisotropic Gram ranking
routes.fact: 254 distinct finalists rejected; anisotropy showed no clear advantage over uniform weighting.
routes.limit: Better residual scores did not establish a solution.

routes.title: Braids / random matrices
routes.fact: Ginibre discriminant winding -11 at five sampling resolutions.
routes.limit: Numerical winding is not full braid information; no certificate-map monodromy was constructed.

routes.title: Yang / typed relations
routes.fact: A19 and A30 have equal H1 but different H0 in the selected graded complexes.
routes.limit: Yang sheaf theorems are not instantiated; no typed-cache advantage is inferred.

routes.title: Bourbaki / Dolgachev / Shafarevich
routes.fact: Fixed fiber: length120, with117 simple points and one length3 point. Scalar pole orders1 and5 on specified arcs.
routes.limit: These are scoped fiber/slice calculations, not a global support or solution.

routes.title: Eisenbud / Koszul
routes.fact: All75 homogeneous quadratic-direction polar parameters excluded for cyclic-triple-fano.
routes.limit: Arbitrary degree7 denominators and the instance remain open.
